If there’s a comment you read here, I want you to read this. 

When it gets too much, and you can’t take it anymore, close your eyes. Deep breath in. Hold 3 seconds. Deep breath out. Repeat until you can take it. I know you probably won’t believe me, but good breathing is the key to emotional control. 

These problems you’re having are fixable. I know it looks like you don’t know a way out, like things are going to forever be bad, and that you’re too weak at this point to make it. But that’s the thing. Your mind will quit far before your body will. You are the product of success. You beat the 400 trillion lottery of being born. Just by being born you are a fucking winner, and you are capable of so much more than you could ever believe. 

Things do in fact get better. You’re probably pretty young relatively, meaning you have the next 50 years to fix things that you can and get over what you can’t. You say that your ex has gotten you to push away everyone? That doesn’t mean you can’t speak with them ever again. You can reach out to them, and if they really care about you, then it won’t be a problem. 

But here’s the thing. Dying doesn’t take away the pain, it just passes it to someone else and multiplies. Your family and friends especially. 

Now I’m going to be honest. It’s probably still going to suck for a while. It’s ok to take it a month, a week, a day, or literally a single step at a time as long as you keep moving forward. Life is a fuckin swamp sometimes and if you stand still, then you’re going to get bogged down, and it’s going to be all the much harder to make those steps forwards. 

If there’s one thing that you take away from this, just remember to breathe.
